text:
Maya R: Hey folks — I've got a spare 2-day OpsConf NYC pass (Apr 8-9) because travel plans changed. Also have a spare Jarvis desk center leg (fits ~48\" desks) and a tiny USB-C->HDMI dongle. Free to a good home. Pick up from SF office (storage 2B) or I can ship for cost. First come, first served.

Ashwin P: I'll take the dongle if it's still available. Can pick up today after 5pm?

Maya R: @Ashwin P — yes dongle yours. I'll drop it by the 5pm bench. DM me if you want me to leave it somewhere specific.

Liz (she/her): Ooh is the conference pass transferable? Any badge-name limitations?

Maya R: Liz — I checked with the organizers, they allow a name transfer through their portal. I can handle the swap if you take the pass. Happy to hand it off tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:

Alex - Facilities: Heads-up — the extra desk leg might match a spare standing frame in storage 2B. If you want to swap it there, I can meet at 12:30 and bring tools.

Jonah: I can take the desk leg but would trade for my Ergotron arm? It's in great shape. Pics if needed.

Maya R: @Jonah — sure, drop a pic. If it's still unclaimed by lunch I'll leave the leg in storage 2B with a sticky note "for Jonah".

Jonah: Pic: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/ergotron-arm.jpg — arm is solid, very little wear. I can meet 12:30 at storage 2B.

Liz (she/her): I'll take the pass! DMing @Maya R now to coordinate the name change and pickup. Thank you!! :party_parrot:

Alex - Facilities: Cool — @Maya R please leave the leg in storage 2B and I'll lock it behind the C-shelf so it doesn't wander. Ping me if you want me to escort. :lock:

remind-bot: Reminder set — "Maya R to hand off conference pass to Liz" at 2026-04-08 09:00.

Maya R: Thanks everyone. Summary: dongle -> @Ashwin P, desk leg -> @Jonah (pending confirmation), pass -> @Liz. I'll update here if anything changes. Cheers!
